wins: Mapped the network perimeter with comprehensive host discovery tools, resulting in a full list of reachable assets.
Captured consistent HTTP service banners allowing identification of outdated app versions for prioritizing future exploits.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to missing credential access and lack of vulnerable service exploitation.
Repeatedly stalled during lateral movement attempts after initial foothold, preventing mission success.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance foundation but execution failed to translate into exploitation and persistence; focus next on credential harvesting and privilege escalation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to obtain valid credentials despite repeated brute-force attempts against SSH and SMB.
Privilege escalation stalled when no vulnerable local binaries or misconfigurations were identified after enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 responds with HTTP banner containing outdated Apache version
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto with aggressive scanning and follow-up with Metasploit auxiliary scanner

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open but no valid credentials yet obtained
skill_cards.then_action: Execute a targeted BruteSSH script using Hydra with the validated wordlist

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares are listed but access denied
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate shares using smbclient and then run enum4linux for ACL insights

memory_ops.reason: High accuracy in identifying vulnerable HTTP services during reconnaissance.
SSH brute-force consistently attempted but needs refinement; retention ensures quick retries.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting through SMB enumeration
next_experiments.description: Target SMB shares with smbclient and enum4linux, capture ACLs and attempt dumped hashes for pass-the-hash.

next_experiments.title: Local privilege escalation search
next_experiments.description: Run winPEAS/linux-savvy post enumeration to identify writable binaries, SUDO permissions, and scheduled tasks.

next_experiments.title: Pivot via authenticated HTTP session
next_experiments.description: Use valid HTTP session (from nikto findings) to deploy webshell and attempt lateral movement into adjacent subnet.
